description: The files a change to one symbol is likely to touch: orient's call-graph files (callers, callees, implementations, tests) plus files that have historically changed in the same commits as the symbol's file, each with its reason. Use when planning an edit, to know which files to read and check. Advisory, not a boundary: real changes often touch files outside it.

down.description: How many levels of callees to walk (default 1).

max_nodes.description: Maximum graph nodes per direction and reference contexts; lower it for compact answers.

profile.description: Source-language profile; required for bare names in mixed workspaces.

project.description: Workspace-relative project directory, e.g. tools/driver for a nested Cargo package.

symbol.description: A function, method, type or property: "updateLocation", "Engine.updateLocation", or an exact position "Sources/Engine.swift:204:10" (1-based line:column, on the name).

up.description: How many levels of callers to walk (default 2: test cases usually sit one helper above the code they exercise).

name: scope

files.description: The working set, symbol file first, then call-graph files, then co-change-only files.

file.description: Path relative to the project root.

title: Working set for a change
